model: hssr-q6d-moises-a (hssr_model.bin): the q6d scene controller, 93.75 controls/s
set_in: deploy/smartphone_integrator/carplay_startup.sh (every value below is checked against it by scripts/check_model_settings.py at package time)
harness: tools/stereo-upmix-render/upmix_behavior_tests.py VARIANTS['shipped'] = the same knobs as renderer flags

AUDIO_STEREO_UPMIX.what: stereo -> 5.1 upmix on the buffered CarPlay stream

AUDIO_REALTIME_UPMIX.what: the same upmix for the stock realtime media stream (type 100), own DSP state

AUDIO_STEREO_SURROUND.what: rear object level; 0.5 was tried 25.09 and flickered +45 %

AUDIO_STEREO_FRONT_RETENTION.what: half of each rear object stays in front (21.09)

AUDIO_HSSR_RETENTION_HF.what: HF retention taper; unset = renderer default, the taper itself rode on the attack detector and is off with it

AUDIO_HSSR_BED_ATTACK.what: attack detector off since 25.09: its per-hit collapse was the largest jump generator; 22.09 ran owner

AUDIO_HSSR_ATTACK_COLLAPSE.what: collapse depth of the attack detector; unused while BED_ATTACK=off (22.09: 0.75)

AUDIO_STEREO_REAR_BODY_DB.what: rear body trim; unset = renderer default

AUDIO_STEREO_REAR_AIR_DB.what: static rear air bed above ~2.5 kHz (25.09); -12 = the 22.09 rear treble level; -9 since 27.09: the mask rear was 1.6 dB darker than 22.09 above 2.5 kHz; unset = off

AUDIO_STEREO_FRONT_TREBLE_DB.what: front high shelf @4 kHz, -12..0; unset = off (the static lever if the front is too bright, -3 tried)

AUDIO_STEREO_FRONT_BASS_DB.what: front-only bass trim, sub and rears untouched

AUDIO_STEREO_LFE.what: sub from the front bass assist

AUDIO_STEREO_LFE_GAIN.what: dB re the 07.09 calibration; the 18.09 build ran +9.5 and boomed

history.2026-09-22 (car, listened): BED_ATTACK=owner, ATTACK_COLLAPSE=0.75, VOCAL_GATE=0, no rear air (harness VARIANTS['car_0922'])
history.2026-09-27 evening (car, listened): mask net live for the first time (reset handoff fixed); MASK_DRIVE 1.0 -> 1.3 -> 1.5, REAR_AIR -12 -> -9; 1.7 rejected (22.09 leak and swing)
